skins.name: Default Outfit
skins.content:
Clothes Zima wears when traveling around Deity Grypherburg and its surrounding areas.
When she met with the tailor invited by the House of Rostov, she had only one request: she wanted a patch of red sewn onto the chest.

skins.name: Default Outfit
skins.content:
Zima stands amongst the people.
She is no charismatic chieftain, no craven coward. She stands, her flag held high.
